examples.title: Configure an EXR Write node
examples.code:
# Create a Write node for an EXR sequence.
write = nuke.createNode("Write")
write["file"].setValue("D:/renders/final.####.exr")
write["file_type"].setValue("exr")
write["channels"].setValue("all")

# Change the output to RGB only.
write["channels"].setValue("rgb")

examples.title: Render a Write node over a frame range
examples.code:
# Create and configure a Write node before rendering.
write = nuke.createNode("Write")
write["file"].setValue("D:/renders/test.####.exr")
write["file_type"].setValue("exr")

# Render frames 1001 through 1010.
nuke.execute(write, 1001, 1010)
